protect.requirement: Keep all bytes before selected region unchanged, including accepted Configuration treatment; no mandatory file/load-set changes.

rewrite_map.compact_form: One shared consumer-fold rule and a table mapping review/spec-review/ship/spec to block info-string, consumer, CLI and fallback. Keep each distinct coercion/outage behaviour in table.
rewrite_map.existing_source: Existing faff contract review-verdict/spec-review-verdict/delivery-outcome/spec-readiness commands and their already cited --describe surfaces; no new compulsory describe calls or reads.

rewrite_map.compact_form: One load rule, deterministic scope command, once-per-run cache and mode/pass/fail table; optional configured structural preflight in one sentence.
rewrite_map.existing_source: faff validate-adapters --is-bundled <occupant> --slot <slot>; --configured; existing Sibling-skill invocation in same already-loaded kernel.

rewrite_map.repeat: Delivery repeats fixed outcome/coercion, CI-empty is not green, nondelegable floor and producer vs caller cleanup ownership.
rewrite_map.compact_form: Keep one floor/readiness authority table, one precondition-routing rule and exact delivery-fold/corroboration rule; remove parallel explanations and historical adaptor-retirement prose.
rewrite_map.existing_source: kernel earlier Worktree/Sibling rules remain in same load; existing contract and merge-gate commands own deterministic vocabulary/coercion.

rewrite_map.repeat: Readiness repeats retained confidence/live-thread invalidation and prose-vs-contract placement explanations for marker metadata.
rewrite_map.compact_form: Single retained-rating/reconciliation rule plus marker, optional metadata and provenance tables. Keep exact distinct effects and extraction regex; avoid four narrations of why metadata is not a contract field.
rewrite_map.existing_source: Existing spec-readiness contract and already-required tracker/autonomous references for callers that load them; kernel must still state unique all-caller obligations without requiring those files newly.

unique_rules_to_retain: Fixed branch/count/admission contracts never become slot-owned; producer blocks differ from routing/rendering adaptors.
Consumers load kernel; direct foreign occupant loads its canonical home; install-relative resolution, never hardcoded dev path. Preserve existing load semantics without introducing a new read.

--is-bundled exit0 only correct registered slot; foreign/wrong-slot/error validates, once per occupant per run. Autonomous parks only affected unit; interactive stops; configured preflight is structural, not semantic proof.
Review malformed→human judgement; provider unavailable is known distinct nonpass state. Absent-block extraction fallback remains explicit.
Spec-review approval requires zero objections; nonapproval requires founded objections; malformed/absent never approves.
Delivery is corroborated-only success, preconditions→retry-later not failed/needs-human, readiness may add refusal but never subtract integrity floor. Empty CI never passes.
Routing admits only build-ready states, surfaces all others, invalidates cached rating/verdict after live-thread steering; no stale snapshot shortcut.
Retain confidence on attached spec; medium is human triage not automatic admission; failed resolve-attempt parks with stated root cause.
Retain exact Chosen/Punt/Assumes marker obligations, optional decides-owner parsing and silent-unowned fallback, human-only ratification authority/carry-forward/gating effect.
Retain provenance stamp placement and unknown model/version behaviour, git-only suffix exception and producer/consumer provenance_present split.
Rendering has no branchable internal contract; every terminal/tracker description/comment normalises, only skill-source/internal logs exempt.

existing_tests_and_evidence.covers: Actual contract input/output/coercion goldens and enum-bound describe semantics. Reuse existing cases; no new adapter needed for unchanged command truth.
Structural/enum/routing checks. Bundled predicate implementation is validate-adapters.js:713; do not infer semantic foreign-validation proof from lint.

Prior bounded actual producer/consumer records are reusable provenance/reference, not automatic qualification of a rewritten shared kernel. Source flags and scope remain those of each original record.

planning_savings.basis: Remove about34.5% of29KB through repeated fold/validation/authority explanations and historical rationale, retaining unique rules locally. Plausible source-draft target, not a measured lower bound or accepted saving.
planning_savings.do_not_claim: No exact amount until root authors candidate and bytewise obligation review confirms it.

caveats: Shared core includes inherited stale literal gateway-loading/adaptor wording and L4-label-only holdout descriptions. Do not silently resolve those while dieting or replace newer capability-based rules elsewhere with them.
Some caller refs are mandatory only for particular entries. Do not move kernel unique rules to a file not already mandatory for every affected consumer.

No full foreign-occupant semantic or complete workflow coverage is established by command goldens. Bounded source comparison and existing relevant consumers suffice for a draft checkpoint; future acceptance requires explicitly scoped evidence.
limits: Read selected29KB region and named test headers/assertions; mechanical planning only. No source edits, test runs, model calls, new harness or accepted accounting change.
